unresolved_ambiguities.reason: The requirement text suggests an optional or preferred action ('preferably'), while the controlled context explicitly mandates the same action ('mandatory'). Without clarification on which rule takes precedence or the scope of 'critical control modules' versus the general requirement, the intent cannot be safely resolved.
